plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: Draft
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: The CI has been created but is still being defined. Information is incomplete and the CI is not yet approved for further lifecycle activities.

plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: Design
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: The CI is in the planning or design phase. Architecture, requirements, and specifications are being developed.

plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: Build
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: The CI is currently being developed, configured, or implemented and is not yet ready for production use.

plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: Available
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: The CI is ready for deployment or assignment but is not yet actively providing a production service.

plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: Operational
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: The CI is deployed, fully functional, and actively supporting business or IT services in production.

plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: In Maintenance
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: The CI is temporarily undergoing maintenance, upgrades, or repairs. It may have limited or no availability during this period.

plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: End of Support
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: Vendor or internal support has ended or has been scheduled to end. The CI may still be operational but will no longer receive support, updates, or patches.

plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: End of Life
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: The CI has reached the end of its intended lifecycle and should no longer be used for production. Replacement or retirement should be planned or completed.

plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: Expired
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: The CI is no longer valid due to the expiration of its license, certificate, contract, subscription, or other time-based entitlement.

plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: Decommissioned
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: The CI has been permanently removed from service and is no longer operational. It is retained in the CMDB for historical, audit, or compliance purposes.

plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.name: Cancelled
plugins/service-specification/lifecycles.description: The CI was planned but the implementation or deployment was cancelled before becoming operational.
